beats.headline: Seen in the first episode
beats.text: I'm on the show. The first episode of Dungeon Crawler World: Earth, and I'm in it, so everybody with a screen has seen me now, including a man with no shoes and his cat. I watched the whole thing. I didn't say anything while it was on. I liked it more than I thought I would.

beats.headline: A Lajabless
beats.text: I am grown now. A Lajabless. Half the day I am beautiful, and my spells cost half, and I am half as strong. The other half my face is a skull, and I am twice as strong. My right leg is a goat's leg now, with a hoof. I can't run on walls any more. My dogs stay dogs. They look at me funny. My class is Black Inquisitor General. Cleric, magic-user, warrior. All three.

beats.headline: A feud, according to the recap
beats.text: The recap has a feud now. The cat, against my dogs, Cici and Gustavo. The cat says she never challenged anybody. The show says she did. Everybody watching heard the show. I know which one I am going to listen to.

beats.headline: First on the board
beats.text: First on the draft leaderboard, and by a distance: Lucia Mar, Lajabless, Black Inquisitor General, level twenty-nine, bounty one million, twice the next name down. Odette explains afterwards that the number is what other crawlers get for killing her. Princess Donut calls her ugly on air, and the audience laughs.

beats.headline: Still first, on the recap
beats.text: The show plays me pulling the head off one of the janitor ghouls in a train car. The blood goes everywhere and I am laughing. Then the board comes up. One. Lucia Mar. Lajabless. Black Inquisitor General. Level thirty. A million gold on me. The cat is seven. The man is six. A hundred thousand each.

beats.headline: Banned for life
beats.text: On the recap I make a necklace out of monster tongues. I am in a saferoom eating a bowl of rice, and one of my dogs sneaks up and takes it off my neck. The club at the stations will not let me in. Banned for life. I have tried a few times now. They are ready for me.

beats.headline: A room with five stairwells
beats.text: I find the room. It is big. There are five stairwells in it, in a circle. Then the zombie things come. I fight them. They keep coming. They keep coming. I fall back.

beats.headline: I told him I would
beats.text: The station is almost empty and there is a line at the stairs. This is mine. The crocodile man says crazy bitch where he thinks I can't hear. I throw a boy at him. He says I'm not right in the head. There is nothing wrong with my head. I tell him if he talks again there will be something wrong with his girlfriend's head. He talks again. Cici and Gustavo go for him and he shoots all three of us. We don't get hurt. She does. I told him I'd do it. He shoots me again, and I slide across the ice and down the stairs.

beats.headline: Gustavo, after the battle
beats.text: After a battle, Gustavo kills a group of crawlers. Gustavo is the smaller one. Everybody says he did it by accident. They say accident like it has quotation marks around it. Then I am not all right. I am worse than usual. They show me sitting in a room by myself, and I am crying. They put that on the show.

beats.headline: The smaller dog
beats.text: The recap shows me in my beautiful shape. A borough boss that looks like a stegosaurus. I put my damage reflect on the smaller of my two dogs. The boss crushes him. The damage goes back to the boss, and the boss dies. The dog is fine. I pull out the dead boss's eye with my bare hand and bite it like an apple. I am laughing.

beats.headline: Mayor of Alucarda
beats.text: This village is Alucarda. It already has a name, which the cat does not like. The mayor was R'aggah. He has returned to the earth. The mayor is me now. The tree man at the saferoom door tells the man so: an evil woman with two beasts that kill indiscriminately. The man asks where I am. Nobody answers him. He is gone before they can. The cat is still here.

beats.headline: She killed the wrong one
beats.text: The cat fought good. I say it's a draw and order two milks. The bear goes to get them and doesn't come back. Alexandro is mad. He says I should finish her. I tell the cat about Bini and Abraham and Siti, on the ice, and how I fell asleep and didn't tell Gus to sleep. Gus is the bad one. Then I tell Cici to kill the kitty, and the cat drops Cici's head through the floor. She killed the wrong one. Where's my milk? Yes. They all must die. No more friends.

beats.headline: Against the wall
beats.text: I stand against the wall and chew my fingernail. The crocodile comes across the room at me, and the man puts a hand on his chest and stops him. Florin just stares at me for a long time. Then something in his face goes soft, and he tells the man something is off with me. I run along the wall to the corner by the stage. I sit down on the floor and hold on to myself.

beats.headline: More than one of her in there
beats.text: Florin held on to me. He is kind to me even when I'm not the one who is here. He told the others that there is more than one of us in my head, and that some of the others are children too, and that the dog is the important part. He's right about the dog. I don't get to talk about the dog. I'm not the one who decides what I talk about.

beats.headline: She does not do the boss fight
beats.text: When the seal breaks I hide behind Florin with my hands over my ears while he shoots, and I cry. Then the castle is gone and everyone hangs in the air for a boss fight. I don't stay for it. I always set my teleports at stairwells. The moment before the fight starts, I use my escape thing, and I am gone.

beats.headline: What happened in Beijing
beats.text: I don't collect cards. They give me six totems anyway, all low ones. When a battle starts I throw the first one away and play the rest until my hand is empty, and then I can use my spells and my magic and my inventory. Me and my dog go in and kill everything. At the Soho building everybody fights. I set a teleport trap, and Fang's team is in it. He has a key. I kill him and his wife and take it. Florin asked me to help, so I wait for his friends. The cat and I have a score to settle. Next floor. Her and her dinosaur.

beats.headline: I don't want to play anymore
beats.text: I come up the tower for the dinosaur. That is justice. The cat throws barrels at Gus and he keeps sliding away from me, and I tell him to get back up. Then something hits me, and I tumble down the ramp with a crab, into the man. The crab holds me up in his claws and shouts at me to kowtow. I say please. I say I don't want to play anymore. The man breaks a bottle on my head, and it screams.

beats.headline: My name is Diah
beats.text: Sir. My name is Diah. Lucia is with Alexandro, and Alexandro is only here when the dogs are close. Wait until the dog is close, and Lucia will be back. Please, sir. We are in the dark, and it is so cold. Sometimes we hear them whispering. It's like a river runs through our room, and if we touch it, it hurts. When the dog wanders off, Lucia fades, and one of us takes over, and we can see again. We take turns. Sometimes it is day.

beats.headline: Another ally for the Eulogist
beats.text: The dog is dead, and I am on my knees, crying, pouring a pet potion on the dinosaur, whose throat is open. You did it, I tell him. Then I stand up. A blast from the tower goes past my head and I don't flinch. I tell the man he should have killed us both when there was still a connection. Now it's too late. Now the Eulogist has another ally in the dungeon, and he can't kill me. Not unless he wants all the children of Earth to die. I walk off.

beats.headline: One hundred and twenty thousand
beats.text: This is not a death notice. Read it anyway. Crawler Lucia Mar is a dead man's switch. The administration puts the number at roughly a hundred and twenty thousand human children on the surface, and every one of them stops when she does. That is not a figure of speech and it is not a rounding error. Some of them already talk out of her mouth. Nobody has said what for. Don't look at me. I'd think about that, crawler, and then I would think very hard about something else.

beats.headline: Chalchiuhtlicue is here
beats.text: I look at the man and the cat. Then I am close to him, closer than he likes. Chalchiuhtlicue is here. She is new. She says she is kind and she will protect us. She says the kindest thing may be letting us die. We are vessels in the river, and so is he. The veins are open. Everything trapped is coming, for the prize on the twelfth floor. It is not a game like they told me. It is not a game like they told him.

beats.headline: A rope with a door in it
beats.text: I have a new rope. It is gold. Inside the loop the air is a door. The mimic that was pretending to be a gambler is a blob now, so I put the loop over its head. The part of it inside the loop goes somewhere else. Then I close the door. The rest of it stays in the room and falls over. Its bottom half spills on the floor. I look for the next one.

beats.headline: Good boy
beats.text: Carl is a dog now. The small long kind. I am in the beautiful shape today. I lean over him, and then I go down on one knee and pat him on the head. Good boy, I tell him. Then I get up and walk out of the room. Behind me the cat says something about dog people. I don't turn round.

beats.headline: Someone at her leg
beats.text: Florin is still asleep, so I carry him. I was sick earlier, on my hands and knees. Nobody came. I stand in front of the stairwell. A girl is holding on to my leg. She is about five. The man shouts stop. I don't stop. The three of us step into the portal.
